config.primary_rule: At each real Binance daily close, if the current-quarter futures contract's annualized basis (log-linear extrapolation of (future_close/spot_close - 1) to a 365-day year) is >= 8%, enter a delta-neutral cash-and-carry trade (long spot + short the quarterly future, equal notional) at next day's open with the full accrued reserve; hold to contract expiry (basis converges to zero by settlement), realize the captured basis net of 4-leg round-trip costs (spot buy/sell + futures short/cover), then wait 1 day before re-evaluating.
